knownFailingFactoryCheck.scope: Only 13 of the 25 are VF-SRC-A's (VF13 four, VF17 nine). VF14, VF15 and VF16 belong to other workers, so this is a fleet-level dispatch gap rather than anything specific to this return.

knownFailingFactoryCheck.whatWouldFixIt: add an assignment entry for VF13 through VF17 to ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENTS.json listing each lane's families, so the dispatch record matches the grants that already exist.
knownFailingFactoryCheck.doesItInvalidateThisReturn: No. The grants themselves are live and were asserted and released normally, and verify-claim-ledger.mjs reads CLAIM_LEDGER_OK across all 537 claims. What is missing is the dispatch row, not the grant.
